title_working: The Secret Behind Our School's Weirdest Rule

lines.text: Nobody tells new kids the secret behind our school's weirdest rule.
lines.say: (serious) Nobody tells new kids the secret behind our school's weirdest rule.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: There's a sign in every classroom. Never say, it's quiet today.
lines.say: (serious) There's a sign in every classroom. Never say, it's quiet today.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On Leo's first day, the class was silent. So he smiled and said it.
lines.say: (happy) On Leo's first day, the class was silent. So he smiled and said it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone gasped. Then the recess bell rang, two hours early.
lines.say: (nervous) Everyone gasped. Then the recess bell rang, two hours early.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The board started flashing one word. Recess.
lines.say: (happy) The board started flashing one word. Recess.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The teacher spun around. Who said it?
lines.say: (angry) The teacher spun around. Who said it?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Leo turned and saw the quiet girl in the back holding a tiny remote.
lines.say: (nervous) Leo turned and saw the quiet girl in the back holding a tiny remote.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then Pia winked at him. She built it herself, for extra recess.
lines.say: (happy) Then Pia winked at him. She built it herself, for extra recess.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Leo never told anyone. Now they're best friends.
lines.say: (confident) Leo never told anyone. Now they're best friends.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That's the secret nobody tells new kids. And tomorrow, there's a new kid.
lines.say: (serious) That's the secret nobody tells new kids. And tomorrow, there's a new kid.
lines.speaker: narrator
